_metadata.reason: The classic RM's per-instrument ceiling became virtual x ratio instead of available x ratio (TradeRiskManagement._size_prioritized_orders). Trades 0-5 are byte-identical -- with an empty sleeve available == virtual, so the old ceiling was already right. From trade 6 the sizes rise (38->67, 32->58, 30->55, 27->44, 52->64, 49->60, 42->63, 28->43, 36->51, 79->84): those are the later entries that had been squeezed by a ceiling that shrank as the book filled. Entry prices are unchanged; P&L moves with size; final equity 100,150.68 -> 101,128.15. Not a regression -- the previous values were produced by the defect this release fixes.
